verdict.rationale: Vendor claims of 3D V-Cache boosting gaming performance and high core/thread counts are directly corroborated by independent reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware) showing the 9950X3D as fastest 16-core gaming chip, near-parity with 9800X3D, and beating Intel competitors by significant margins in real game benchmarks. Missing for 10: no independent iGPU-specific gaming benchmarks and no frame-time/1% low breakdown across a wider game suite.
